unreachable.definition: oracle over committed candidates is 0 - no usable trajectory committed the correct answer
unreachable.note: every verifier that scores committed candidates gets 0 on these by construction, while they remain in the denominator of any mean over the 78

a5b_flagged_overlap.note: A.5b's flagged set (18 distinct instances; the 3 extraction failures are a subset of the 18 singled-out, not additional to them) is drawn from phase2b's 45 no-correct instances; the no-correct axis cuts across stratum B (D-37), so the overlap with the frozen 78 is real rather than hypothetical

preregistration.primary: Delta on all 78 against the existing 0.0641 bar, unchanged, for direct comparability with D-38
preregistration.secondary: Delta on the reachable subset against its own recomputed bar, since unreachable instances contribute zero to the numerator while sitting in the denominator
